name: Repair Text Block
description:
Not every fan fault needs a new part. A loose grille, blades packed with dust, a tired speed controller and a dead motor all produce similar symptoms, and we can usually tell them apart from a photo and a short description.

Tell us what happens when the sauna powers up, add the brand and model of the cabin, and attach photos of the fan and its wiring. A specialist replies with the diagnosis, the part you need, and what the repair involves.
